rohit: Quick sync — we're putting the new longform-int4 canary into traffic tomorrow morning. Need a rapid pass on the promptset: prune duplicative longform prompts, refresh golden examples, and lock labeling slots. Who can own dedupe + golden refresh today?

elin: I can take dedupe. Plan to run fuzzy-hash then manual 2k sample pass. Will surface ambiguous clusters for review. ETA 4pm PT.

sam: Reminder from the quant bench: the int4 config is producing subtle repetition in 2-3 turn convo prompts — we should add ~200 targeted examples that stress long-range context to the golden. Otherwise the eval metrics hide real regressions.

nora: I'll coordinate labeler capacity. Can we split into 3 batches: short (<=256), medium (256-1024), long (>1024)? Labelops, what's current queue and SLA?

labelops: @nora current queue: 1.5k unassigned. Average label time per item: short 45s, medium 120s, long 350s. You have 6 active contractors today. Recommend prioritizing medium then long to surface quant regressions. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

rohit: Good call. Elin — include 200 long-range prompts for the golden refresh (sam's examples). Nora — allocate 3 contractors to long batch for next 6 hours, 2 to medium, rest on short.

elin: Will tag the golden candidates with label "golden_int4_longform_2026-03-23" and push to /shared/curation/qbench/gold-refresh. I'll add a short README with selection heuristics.

sam: Tiny suggestion for the README: note any prompts where the reference output requires >2k tokens — those we should avoid until we validate kv-cache behavior in runtime.

rohit: Agree. Also add a small eval snippet for reproducing the quant regression locally: `python bench/run_compare.py --model longform-int4 --baseline longform-fp16 --prompts golden_int4_longform_2026-03-23 --metrics perplexity,repeat_rate`

curation-bot: Auto-note: golden set created by elin at /shared/curation/qbench/gold-refresh/golden_int4_longform_2026-03-23.json (size 480).

nora: I'll update the labeler assignment sheet and ping the vendors channel once tasks are live. Expect first labeled batch in ~3h.

elin: One more: I'll run a quick semantic-embed de-dupe (`embed-dedup --sim-thresh 0.88`) before fuzzy-hash to catch paraphrases.

rohit: Perfect. Thanks team — we'll reconvene after the first labeled batch and run the bench. :rocket:
